subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c08da4b54bf4bf6bc037d62bfd92b7d0061a92c4d57ea44a471f66827f74bbd.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Middle figure is rotated 90º clockwise direction in the next figure.

2) In every next figure 1 pattern is added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdd6734e1138edc9c5c6c766d870877f3321039b5043938d9833e53fc377a47c.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
